_metadata.description: Provide findings-first, execution-evidence remediation with durable verification.

requirements.title: Evidence-driven remediation is verified
requirements.description: Create one scoped remediation job per scenario from stable execution findings and requirement evidence, delegate only through Agent Manager, and persist a server-owned verification delta.

validation.notes: CLI accepts execution UUID, stable finding IDs, requirement IDs, and a role reference
API rejects generic agent payload controls and exposes remediation-only handlers
Covers single-active-job lifecycle and persisted verification execution evidence
